observed_memory.interpretation: Apple unified-memory resident-set proxy; not discrete VRAM

admission_policy.ordinary_calls: Controllers may share the endpoint without ownership handoffs.
admission_policy.slot_limit: At most four live generation requests.
admission_policy.token_limit: Sum of declared prompt plus maximum completion tokens must not exceed 129024.
admission_policy.affinity: Group byte-identical prompt seeds in the same wave to exploit prefix reuse.
admission_policy.oversize: Do not mix a prompt above 60000 tokens with another long cold-prefix wave.
admission_policy.monitoring: Read OS sockets and server logs while saturated; HTTP status calls queue behind work.

measured_result.cold_mixed_cache_warning: Redundant prefix prefill can dominate and make naive concurrency slower than serial cache-affine sampling.
